62247.sn: …must prevail and obtain favour with God, and get light in himself, get rid of his sins, and all his hardness of heart, for the time is coming when everything that can be shaken will be shaken, and we…

62248.sn: …do repent, if there are not more than three hundred men, we will whip out the unrighteous, for, says the Lord, everything that can be shaken shall be, and that which cannot be shaken will remain.

62249.sn: One of the prophets says, "The gold and the silver are His, and the cattle upon a thousand hills."

62250.sn: God is interested in these things, and he does not care much about the dollars, for the gold and the silver, and the cattle upon a thousand hills are his, the earth in its fullness belongs to him; the…

62251.sn: The Lord declares, I have plenty; I own all things, the gold and the silver are mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills are mine.

62252.sn: The gold and the silver are God's, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

62253.sn: He will yet prove to them that the gold and the silver are His, and the cattle upon a thousand hills, and that He gives to whom He will, and withholds from whom he pleases.

62254.sn: The silver and the gold belong to Him, and the life of all mankind is in His hands.

62255.sn: The gold and the silver and all the mineral wealth of these vast mountains belong to the Lord.
